TUN.note: No link between the civil register and the ID system is stated.
Civil-status operation counts and certificate extracts are stated, but no digital civil register for births or deaths.
Nothing on consumer protection in digital finance.

facts.fact: Foreign Minister Mohamed Ali Nafti told parliament that 40 diplomatic and consular posts (47% of the network) are connected to the E-Consulat system, and that the remote appointment service recorded 13,310 bookings in 2026.

TUN.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
Nothing on ID numbers at birth.
The National Computing Centre is named only as a partner in interconnection projects, with no statement of who builds or runs systems.
No survey share of adults with accounts.
Only certificate extracts from a consular system and operation counts; no local civil office entering events digitally.
Nothing on mobile money or retail payments.

facts.fact: The Foreign Minister said electronic payment of consular services has been introduced in several missions, ahead of progressive generalisation.
